mods.name: Fractured
mods.description: Become a half-slime player with size growth, slime recovery, dormant behavior, and slime-based abilities.

# Fractured v1.3.10 — Alpha Release!! (˶ˆᗜˆ˵) **Another update is here!!** This build lands somewhere around an alpha or beta stage soo it's not fully stable yet, but definitely not completely broken either. > [!IMPORTANT] > The mod is required on **BOTH client and server** sides! If you're looking for a server-side version that is compatible with vanilla clients, check out [this repository](https://github.com/ItzAsyran/fractured_server/releases/). also this mod only support 1.21.11 minecraft for now --- ## Changelog
Added - Added a brand new experimental feature: **Flow State**! This allows you to become a slime and fully control it. - **Activate:** Tap then hold crouch for 2 seconds. - **Exit:** Hold space for 5 seconds. - *(Note: These timers are fully configurable in the settings!)* > [!WARNING] > Flow State is in a very early stage of development, so bugs are pretty much inevitable right now. Use at your own risk!!
Fixed - Fixed the Experiments category not displaying anything in the menu. - Fixed missing classes failing to build due to the IDE randomly deciding not to include them. - Fixed visual display issues where `itemdisplay` was not showing up properly.
--- ## Usage Guide
How to Use & Disable ### How to use To use the mod, make sure it's installed on **both the client and server**. Enable the slime form using the command: ```mcfunction /slime ``` ### How to disable To turn off slime form, simply type: ```mcfunction /slime off ```
